scenes.narration: Microduck learned to walk in a simulation before it ever took a real step.
scenes.on_screen_text: Learned to walk before step one
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real medium shot of Arjun, an Indian man about 35, calm and curious expression, gesturing gently toward the camera in a tidy home studio with a small desktop robot on the table
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: Hugging Face's Microduck is a 25-centimetre walking robot, under 800 grams. Its CEO says it's heading for about 20,000 preorders.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real close-up of a small bipedal hobby robot standing on a wooden desk next to a ruler, soft studio light, shallow depth of field
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: Fifteen motors, a camera, a depth sensor, and a beak that lifts about 100 grams. It walks, crouches, gets up after falls, and can even roller-skate.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real macro shot of small robot servo motors and wiring on an electronics workbench, a tiny camera module visible, warm light
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: So how? Reinforcement learning in a physics simulator. Fall, retry, improve. Then the skill transfers to the real robot. That's sim-to-real.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real over-the-shoulder shot of a monitor showing an illustrative physics simulation of a small robot falling and standing up, in a dim engineering lab
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: At Nvidia GTC Berlin, the live demo robots stumbled and wandered. Real floors are hard.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real wide shot of a technology conference hall with a small robot wobbling on a demo table while a crowd watches, stage lights
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: The software is open source. The hardware designs aren't, according to Pollen.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real close-up of a laptop screen with open-source code beside a small robot part on a desk, soft daylight
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: $399 before tax and shipping. New orders: about four to six months. A dev platform, not a toy.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real shot of hands typing on a laptop with an online checkout page, a small robot box beside it, cozy desk setting
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: A robot that practises in a simulation, then wakes up already walking. Follow for more robots learning to walk.
